AI._comment_Provider: Set to 'Bedrock', 'OpenAI', or 'Anthropic'. Bedrock is the project default.

Bedrock._comment: No API key needed. Uses AWS credential chain: IAM role (prod) → env vars → ~/.aws/credentials (dev).

OpenAI._comment_ApiKey: Set via: dotnet user-secrets set 'AI:OpenAI:ApiKey' 'sk-...' — NEVER in appsettings files.

Anthropic._comment_ApiKey: Set via: dotnet user-secrets set 'AI:Anthropic:ApiKey' 'sk-ant-...' — NEVER in appsettings files.
